title: AxiomWeave
description: A source-grounded content transformation workspace. It turns one authoritative source and a communication brief into audience-ready artifacts, keeping every output traceable to the source it came from.
points: Seven artifact types: executive summary, LinkedIn and X posts, formal advisory, presentation, infographic and video package
Versioned source packs with immutable context manifests per generation job
Source quotations, lineage validation and discrepancy review
Confirm-before-acting action plans and audit records

title: EvidenceGate Replay
description: A passive, evidence-safe packet replay component for network-security streaming experiments. It reads PCAP/PCAPNG captures, preserves event time and order, and streams packets with backpressure.
points: Classic PCAP and PCAPNG reading at any replay speed
Exact event-time preservation and timestamp regression reports
Typed factual TCP/DNS observations and TTL-bounded keyed state
SHA-256 provenance manifests and component benchmarks

title: KrishiMitra
description: An AI crop-advisory assistant. It combines plant-disease image classification with farm and field context, weather, soil and mandi-price data, and explains advice to farmers in plain language.
points: TensorFlow.js disease classifier across 38 PlantVillage classes
Weather forecasts and alerts proxied server-side
Reviewed safety rules and follow-up monitoring
